scripts.test: rm -rf allure-results && npx playwright test && npm run allure:report
scripts.allure:report: rm -rf allure-report && npx allure generate ./allure-results --clean -o ./allure-report && npx allure open ./allure-report
scripts.postinstall: npx playwright install || echo 'Playwright install skipped'
scripts.test:ci: rm -rf allure-results && npx playwright test && npx allure generate ./allure-results --clean -o ./allure-report
